text:
Maya (Product): Short thread to capture live Qs from the all-hands. Folks asked for clearer release windows and what "Optimize" alpha actually means. Can leadership confirm rough timelines and what features we must include for alpha vs. v1?

Carlos (CTO): Broad strokes: target API GA by 2027-04-28 (conservative), Console public beta around 2027-08-15, Optimize alpha by 2027-09-30. These are planning milestones; we'll firm them up after the risk review next Tue.

Ren (ENG-Runtime): For rollout strategy, proposing a smaller, safer canary for initially sensitive customers: start at 0.5%, step to 5% over 7 days, then 20% over another week if stable. Rollback triggers: p99 error spike or sustained CPU mem pressure. Snippet below: 

```
# small-canary.yaml
canary:
  initial_percent: 0.5
  steady_target_percent: 5
  full_target_percent: 20
  step_interval_hours: 24
  rollback_triggers:
    - p99_error_increase_pct: 100
    - sustained_cpu_pct_gt: 80
```

Mei (SRE): On SLOs: recommend classing requests into "short" (<2s typical), "medium" (2-10s), "long" (>10s). Propose short p95 < 150ms, medium p95 < 600ms, availability 99.95% for GA customers. Also: what is our expected cold-start behavior for private deployments?

Maya (Product): Good split. For Optimize alpha: must-haves = batching guidance + quant-profile suggestions + a lightweight cost estimator. Eval-runner / automated regression alerts can wait until beta. UX should be clearly opt-in.

Nina (Support): Support needs the fallback matrix to prepare KB articles. Recommend fallback order: 1) quantized model variant, 2) reduced max_tokens, 3) region failover. Also need an FAQ for what "Optimize" changes might do to output quality.

Ren (ENG-Runtime): We'll add a server-side translational test to compare outputs after quantization and surface a delta score. Also building a conservative quality-gate flag to prevent auto-quantize for flagged customers.

deploy-bot: Canary cluster `rwd-canary-small` updated, image `rwd/serve:2027-04-20-canary` — monitoring dashboards created.

Carlos (CTO): Action items: Maya to publish tentative dates to the roadmap doc by Mon EOD; Ren to post canary playbook & rollback runbook by Wed; Mei to provide SLO proposal and alert thresholds by Wed; Nina to draft support KB skeleton by Fri.

Maya (Product): I'll also add three representative workload prompts for each bucket (short/medium/long) and share on #eng-runtime tomorrow.

Ren (ENG-Runtime): Ack, will add example dashboards (error budget burn, p99 latency, memory pressure).

Mei (SRE): Ack. Will draft incident runbook for canary and GA.

Nina (Support): Ack. Will include customer-facing wording for Optimize opt-in and expected behavior.

Carlos (CTO): Thanks. If any of these dates slip we'll publish a short note and an impact matrix for partners.

Maya (Product): Thanks all 44d — I'll follow up with the roadmap one-pager and ping for signoff.
